page.layout: One printed page, title-page type. Upper block: about 17 short lines of centred text, narrowing downward in an inverted pyramid. Middle: a two-line inscription, centred. Lower half: an engraved picture (an ornamental frame or emblem) with a small line of text at the foot. No margin notes.
page.notes: The scan is very faint and heavily stained. Only the layout of the lines could be seen; the words themselves cannot be read. The lower picture is an engraving and is not transcribed. The line count and lengths are estimates.
